name: 2G Deep Sleep Disposable - Strawberry Slush
description: Unwind with the perfect nighttime companion. The MKX Deep Sleep 2G Disposable combines Liquid Diamonds, Live Resin, and CBN in a premium all-in-one device designed for any evening routine. Initial clinical studies suggest CBN may help keep sleep constant through the night. Featuring a generous 2 grams of premium oil, every puff delivers rich flavor and smooth performance. Choose from three relaxing indica strains—Strawberry Slush, Northern Lights, and Deep Fried Ice Cream—crafted for a flavorful end to the day.
